draft.emotion: warm and informal, reflecting a close family connection
notes: In Spanish, plural nouns take the gender of the mixed group. Even though the word 'papá' is masculine, 'los papás' refers to a mother and father together.
This is much more common and informal than using 'los padres' in everyday conversation.
